title: measurement base schema
description: Mirror of job/base: the same platform mixin, an instrument in place of compute, a sample in place of a material, and the activity mixin for status, timing and operators.

categories.description: Technique this measurement applies, on the same tier ladder that categorizes a model.

_sample.description: Subset of the full information about the sample that was measured, the analogue of job._material.

samplePosition.description: Where on the sample the measurement was taken. Together with _sample this is the join key for per-position data on a combinatorial library.

parent.description: Subset of the full information about the parent measurement, e.g. the grid acquisition that a single extracted spectrum belongs to.

parameters.description: Technique-specific acquisition parameters. Left open at this level and narrowed by the entries in measurements_directory, the way a model's parameters are narrowed by models_directory.

rawFiles.description: Vendor files this record was derived from, referenced rather than embedded.
